metadata.title: Endpoint Identity and Posture

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asserting cryptographically verifiable endpoint identity and posture signals used by access, network, and data control planes.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint identity services, device certificates, TPM-backed keys, attestation mechanisms, and posture signaling services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern defining endpoint identity and posture as cryptographically rooted assertions consumed by Zero Trust decision points.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Endpoint identity and posture assertions apply only to endpoints that satisfy Endpoint Core trust requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint identity aligns with NIST Digital Identity Guidelines for strong, non-repudiable identity binding.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint posture and device identity are explicit inputs into Zero Trust Policy Decision Points.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint posture and identity assertions rely on firmware and platform integrity protections.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cryptographic identity binding and attestation align with IA, SC, and SI control families.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Identity and Posture defines how endpoints cryptographically assert who they are and whether they are in an acceptable state. This pattern produces authoritative identity and posture signals but does not enforce policy, configure endpoints, or respond to threats.

components.title: Cryptographic Endpoint Identity
components.description: Establishes non-clonable endpoint identity using TPM-backed private keys and PKI-issued device certificates.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Reuse or theft of endpoint credentials to impersonate devices.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Hardware-backed cryptographic identity prevents credential cloning.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic credentials are protected against compromise.

components.title: Endpoint Posture Attestation
components.description: Produces verifiable assertions about endpoint state, including boot integrity and security control presence.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Spoofing or falsification of endpoint state to bypass controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Measured boot and attestation provide verifiable posture signals.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms detect unauthorized changes to endpoint components.

components.title: Posture Signal Integrity
components.description: Ensures posture and identity signals are authentic, timely, and non-repudiable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Concealment or manipulation of posture reporting to evade access controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Cryptographic protection and auditability preserve signal integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect posture signal integrity.
